mc.linking.title: 🔗 Discord ↔ Minecraft
mc.linking.body:
Join the whitelist: `/linkmc <username>` + **account**:
• **free** — cracked launchers (TLauncher, SKlauncher, PojavLauncher…)
• **paid** — you bought Minecraft and log in with the official account (you already know you're paid 😉)
⚠️ Free players must pick **free** — choosing *paid* by mistake locks you out of the server.
linkmc.not_username: ⚠️ That doesn't look like a Minecraft username (1–16 letters, digits or underscores).
linkmc.already: ℹ️ **{name}** is already fully on the whitelist.
linkmc.success_stopped: ✅ **{name}** was added to whitelist.json — it applies when the server starts. 🎮
linkmc.note_paid: (paid account — covered on the official launcher **and** free launchers)
linkmc.note_paid_unknown: (you picked **paid**, but Mojang doesn't know this name — only the free/offline entry was added, so it only works via a free launcher. Double-check the spelling or pick free.)
linkmc.note_free: (free account — name is case-sensitive, keep it exactly as your launcher uses it)
linkmc.failed: ⚠️ Something went wrong talking to the panel — try again or ask staff to add you.
linkmc.linked_audit: It's linked to your Discord, so staff can audit who asked for what.
linkmc.usage_title: 📖 **Using /linkmc** — link Discord to Minecraft so you can join:
linkmc.usage_body:
`/linkmc <your minecraft username>` then set **account**:
• **free** — cracked/offline launchers (TLauncher, SKlauncher, PojavLauncher…)
• **paid** — you bought Minecraft and use the official account (you already know you're paid)
⚠️ **Get it right**: free players must pick **free**. If you pick *paid* while playing on a free launcher, you won't be able to join.
Type your username **exactly** as your launcher shows it — it's case-sensitive.
